newsitem.title: UK: UK "wise man" says rate rise a serious mistake.
newsitem.headline: UK "wise man" says rate rise a serious mistake.

text.p: A surprise quarter-point increase in UK interest rates was a serious mistake, said Patrick Minford, Professor of Economics at Liverpool University.
"I think it was quite a serious mistake," Minford, who is also a member of the Treasury's independent panel of economic advisers, told Reuters Financial Television.
"Firstly, I think that the Bank of England has misjudged the degree of overheating and the threat to inflation and is undervaluing the worries in the manufacturing sector."
Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke ordered a 1/4 point rise in base rates, to six percent on Wednesday.
Minford said the move would also push the pound up further. Sterling has already gained more than six percent on a trade-weighted basis since early August.
"It could do considerable damage to the recovery," he said.
